purpose: Human-readable source of truth for approved story character visuals. Future visual passes should preserve locked designs unless explicitly re-approved.

canonNotes: Young adult Pro Hero; attractive, sharp anime face rather than an older/rugged look.
Normal adult Bakugo hairstyle: full spiky blond hair; no undercut/sidecut in the locked base.
Red eyes; face should stay relatively compact rather than long or overly angular.
Large, irregular combat/explosion-type scars on face, neck, shoulders, arms and hands; avoid making every scar look like a thin knife cut.
Off-duty base: black tank top, relaxed black streetwear, black jacket with warm orange-red lining.
Rendering lock: warm muted skin tones, soft painterly cel-shading, dark warm shadows, detailed but clean anime linework, matching the approved 2026-08-23 expression-sheet look.

temporaryFallbacks.smug: neutral until a dedicated Smug/Amused pack is approved

bakugo.legacyRule: Older Bakugo character images are not canonical visual references and should not be selected for new story content.

compatibilityAliases.angry: assets/story/characters/bakugo-angry.png (approved alias of angryClenched for older expression references)
compatibilityAliases.happy: assets/story/characters/bakugo-happy.png (approved alias of happyGenuineGrin for generic happy expression references)
compatibilityAliases.soft: assets/story/characters/bakugo-soft.png (approved alias for softer/warmed expression references)

expressionNotes: Dedicated Angry pack approved 2026-08-24. Angry must read clearly stronger than the Annoyed/Irritated family through face and body language.
Angry poses should vary: clenched restraint, forward/aggressive gesture, seething tension and open shouting are all valid; do not reuse one hand/arm pose across the whole pack.
Explosion Quirk sparks are selective rather than constant. Subtle sparks may appear when anger is escalating; the shouting/high-intensity expression may vent more visible sparks.
Dedicated Happy pack approved 2026-08-25. This pack preserves the locked Bakugo V2 look and the same consistent crop/framing as the other approved off-duty sprites.
Happy should still read very Bakugo: confidence, satisfaction, playfulness and energized warmth rather than a soft generic smile-only approach.
Quirk sparks are not the default for happy expressions. Use them selectively for the highest-energy celebratory/excited variant only.

Dedicated Soft / Caught-off-Guard / Flustered pack approved 2026-08-25. These expressions should preserve the locked Bakugo V2 look and the same off-duty framing/crop used across the approved sprite set.
Bakugo-style softness should remain character-accurate: restrained warmth, reluctant vulnerability, brief surprise, and defensive embarrassment rather than overly sweet or out-of-character softness.

Flustered variants can include blush, tension, averted gaze, hand-to-neck/body-language discomfort, or startled widening of the eyes; they should still read as Bakugo rather than generic shy anime blushing.
